patches:
delta boxEX boxEY boxEZInv
  simp only [realNewMean,realXMean,realYMean,realInvZMean,
    decode_binding,htx,hty]

delta P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.chordLower
  simp only [chordLower, point_eq nodes h]

simp only [jensenDifferenceUpper,
    P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.jensenDifferenceUpper,
    point_eq nodes h, chordLower_eq nodes h]

delta P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.jensenDifferenceUpper
  simp only [jensenDifferenceUpper, point_eq nodes h, chordLower_eq nodes h]

delta P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.lowerDifference
  simp only [lowerDifference, point_eq nodes h]

by_cases hi : inside box
  · cases hj : P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.jensenDifferenceUpper box <;>
      simp only [upperDifference, P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.upperDifference,
        upperBeforeJensen_eq nodes h, jensenDifferenceUpper_eq nodes h, if_pos hi, hj]
  · simp only [upperDifference, P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.upperDifference,
      if_neg hi, upperBeforeJensen_eq nodes h]

delta P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.upperDifference
  by_cases hi : inside box
  · cases hj : P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.jensenDifferenceUpper box <;>
      simp only [upperDifference, upperBeforeJensen_eq nodes h,
        jensenDifferenceUpper_eq nodes h, if_pos hi, hj]
  · simp only [upperDifference, if_neg hi, upperBeforeJensen_eq nodes h]

delta P2OriginalCompactQ80EncloserSourceOnly.fixedUpper
  simp only [fixedUpper, tailUpper_eq nodes h]

simpa only [originalFirstIntegral, kernel, stop,
    P2FirstIntegralSeriesSourceOnly.theta, P2FirstIntegralSeriesSourceOnly.rho]
    using originalFirstIntegral_le_firstBounds_upper

simp [I80.Contains, I80.enclosure, I80.decodeLo, I80.decodeHi,
    Enclosure.Contains, decode]

change x.enclosure.Contains v ↔ decode x.lo ≤ v ∧ v ≤ decode x.hi
  simp [I80.enclosure, I80.decodeLo, I80.decodeHi, Enclosure.Contains, decode]
